On 10 October 2025, nearly 100 electric bus drivers staged a protest at Kathreguppe in Bengaluru city (Bengaluru Urban, Karnataka) demanding timely disbursal of their salaries.

On 10 October 2025, sanitation workers, drivers, members of southern solid waste management service, mostly belonging to Scheduled Caste communities staged a protest in Nagapattinam city (Tamil Nadu) demanding increase in wages, salary slips and Employees' State Insurance (ESI) cards.

On 10 October 2025, hundreds of conservancy workers staged a protest at Ripon building in Chennai city (Tamil Nadu) demanding the DMK-led state government to regularize jobs and fix a minimum wage. The protesters attempted to enter the building and the police detained the protesters.

On 10 October 2025, a large number of students and faculty staged a protest on Bangalore University's Jnana Bharati campus in Bengaluru city (Bengaluru Urban, Karnataka) against a university syndicate member for verbally abusing the faculty.
